title: studio(flow designer): the entry-condition builder reads the object's published metadata, so for a draft-only object it offers no fields — only `previous`
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: measured in the Studio task benchmark baseline (objectstack-ai/objectstack#22180, step 5): with the object `repair_ticket` still an unpublished draft, Studio → Automations → Start node *Record updated* on it → *Entry condition* builder lists only `previous` as a subject; the network log shows `GET /api/v1/meta/object/repair_ticket` → `404` while the draft exists. The author had to switch to Expression mode and type CEL (baseline code-shaped entry 8).

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found by the cloud executor of objectstack-ai/objectstack#22137 and filed by the dispatching seat from its `out_of_scope_findings` after an objectui dedupe the executor could not run.

## What happens

Building an app in Studio naturally means authoring the automation before the first publish. At that point every field the author just created is invisible to the flow's condition builder, because the builder asks for the published object.

## Where it comes from (read in source)

`useObjectFields` (`app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/useObjectFields.ts`) loads fields with `client.get('object', objectName)` — no draft state, no package — and both `ConditionBuilder` and `FlowNodeConfigField` read their field lists through it. A draft-only object answers 404, so the list is empty (objectui `main` `82500a7`).

## Expected

Authoring surfaces read the draft overlay of the package being edited (the `state=draft` + `package` read the Data pillar already uses), so a draft object's fields are offered before its first publish.

## Related

- objectstack-ai/objectui#11843 (open) — the same draft-versus-published split on another surface: the Objects rail lists a draft-only object by its bare API name.
- objectstack-ai/objectui#11783 (open) — object-name inputs resolving metadata per keystroke; a different defect on neighbouring inputs.

## Environment

Studio task benchmark baseline run, 2026-10-08: objectstack `8fc50b76`, objectui `a58626c8` (console built at the `.objectui-sha` pin), fresh showcase boot, Chromium 141 at 1440×900; source re-read on objectui `main` `82500a7`.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *flow entry condition builder subject list only previous for draft object fields 404 published read*: 4 hits (1 open — objectstack-ai/objectui#11843, related above; 3 closed, unrelated).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *Studio flow designer reads the published object not the draft, condition fields missing for unpublished object*: 16 hits; none describes the condition builder's field source.

Dedupe words: flow entry condition builder draft object fields · condition subject list only previous · flow designer reads published object not draft
